products.Description: HOT WATER BOTTLE TEA AND SYMPATHY

retail.definition: Gross positive sales after exact-row deduplication; excludes cancellations, nonpositive quantity/price and invalid dates. Returns reported separately, not subtracted. Missing customer IDs retained in sales and excluded from customer analysis.

segments.method: log1p → StandardScaler → KMeans; k=2…6 selected by silhouette. PCA is a display projection, not a classifier.
segments.limitation: Internal descriptive validation on the same population; no ground-truth segments or evidence of campaign uplift.

basket.method: Exact frequent 2-itemset counting across invoice baskets. Binary presence per invoice. Minimum support 0.5% (at least 20 invoices), confidence >=20%, lift >1. Rules ranked by lift; top 80 published.
basket.limitation: Descriptive co-occurrence on full history. No held-out cross-sell uplift, multi-item antecedents, or causal recommendation claims.

purchase.protocol: Stratified 60/20/20 split after deduplication. Preprocessing fits training only. Model selected by validation average precision; threshold selected by validation F1. Previously inspected historical test reused for reproducibility; not a fresh external test. No refit after test.
purchase.limitation: Session-complete benchmark, not a real-time or causal conversion promise. No timestamps for temporal validation. Random split cannot measure future-period drift. Browser simulator uses evaluated logistic regression, even if random forest wins.

wholesale.method: log1p → StandardScaler → KMeans; k=2…6 selected by silhouette. PCA is a display projection, not a classifier.
wholesale.limitation: Internal descriptive validation on the same population; no ground-truth segments or evidence of campaign uplift.

forecast.protocol: Four expanding-window 28-day origins. First three origins select by MAE; fourth is the reused chronological test benchmark, previously inspected during development. Aggregate metrics include all four and are labeled backtest metrics. Final forecast refits the selected rule on all history.
forecast.limitation: Historical gross-sales planning baseline; the final source day may be partial. Zero-filled dates assume no recorded sales. No causal, promotion, holiday, or prediction-interval model. Forecast follows the historical dataset, not today.
